name: Forever Us
source:
Kiran Rinaldi awakens one day, confused about how her surroundings, herself, and life in general. All she knows is she is waiting for her parents to return. As she goes about her routine, she remembers more and more about her life.

Taking place in the Rinaldi Sanctum, a centuries-old seaside sanctum dedicated to the goddess of death,  she struggles to adjust to a life that feels strangely unfamiliar. Early on, she is reunited with Aizia Callow who presents as an a kind, albeit eccentric and possibly dangerous childhood friend whose fascination with death is matched only by her unwavering devotion to Kiran.

As the days pass, forgotten memories begin to resurface, unsettling truths come to light, and the line between grief and obsession grows dangerously thin. Faced with a love that refuses to accept mortality, Kiran must ultimately decide whether to let go... or remain forever. 

[From [url=https://omnihil-media.itch.io/forever-us]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，基兰·里纳尔迪 (Kiran Rinaldi) 醒来，对周围的环境、自己和生活感到困惑。她只知道，她正在等待父母的归来。当她继续日常生活时，她对自己的生活记得越来越多。

故事发生在里纳尔迪圣殿（Rinaldi Sanctum），一座拥有数百年历史的海边圣所，供奉着死亡女神，她努力适应一种陌生的生活。早些时候，她与艾齐亚·卡洛重聚，艾齐亚·卡洛是一位善良、古怪、可能危险的儿时好友，她对死亡的迷恋与她对基兰坚定不移的忠诚相匹配。

随着时间的流逝，被遗忘的记忆开始重新出现，令人不安的真相逐渐浮出水面，悲伤和痴迷之间的界限变得危险地薄弱。面对拒绝接受死亡的爱情，基兰必须最终决定是放手……还是永远留下。

[来自[url=https://omnihil-media.itch.io/forever-us]itch.io[/url]]
